result.summary: The food delivery home screen has several layout overflow issues: restaurant names and category chips are clipped, the Orders tab is missing its icon, and a restaurant card is cut off at the bottom.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated on the right edge of the Fastest near you row, so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, slightly reduce type size, or add an ellipsis plus enough padding so names remain fully visible in the card.

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation has a label but no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g. a receipt or bag) so the tab bar is consistent and easier to scan.

issues.description: The last Popular restaurant card (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off by the bottom navigation, hiding the restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset so cards can scroll fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The category chip row is clipped on the right; 'Healthy' is cut and the next chip is only a sliver.
issues.suggestion: Make the chip row clearly horizontally scrollable with peeking padding, or wrap/scale chips so none are abruptly cut off.
